reading: The report describes a growing concentration of suspected sabotage incidents at European military and defence facilities.
Germany has blamed Russia for an attack involving explosive drones at Leipzig airport.
The airport is used by Ukraine to transport military supplies.
Suspicious fires at other defence facilities have raised concerns, although some may ultimately be judged accidental.
Investigators in Estonia are considering possible Russian involvement following a factory fire and arrests.
Slovak police have reported preventing a fire attack on a Ukrainian-owned drone manufacturer.
One analyst interprets the suspected campaign as an attempt to pressure countries supporting Ukraine.
Another sees it as a way to test vulnerabilities and assess governments’ willingness to respond.
Russia is the main suspect in the report.
